Overview

A Mobile Developer at Navy Federal supports the development, maintenance, and enhancement of mobile banking applications across iOS and Android platforms. Mobile Developers work within cross-functional Agile teams and help deliver secure, reliable, and user-friendly digital experiences that align with business goals and member needs.

Mobile Developers collaborate with product owners, designers, quality engineers, backend engineers, and other technical partners throughout the software development lifecycle. Their work includes translating requirements into mobile features, integrating applications with services and APIs, testing code, resolving defects, improving platform stability, and following platform-specific development standards.

At the Associate level, the emphasis is on learning, foundational contribution, and professional growth. Associate Mobile Developers complete clearly scoped development work under guidance, participate in team delivery activities, apply feedback, and build the technical and collaboration skills needed to become increasingly independent contributors.

The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027. Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later.

Responsibilities



- Assist with designing, developing, and maintaining mobile banking features for iOS and/or Android applications.
- Build small, clearly scoped features, user interface components, and defect fixes under the guidance of experienced developers.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
- Collaborate with developers, product owners, designers, quality engineers, and backend engineers to understand requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
- Write and maintain unit and user interface tests that support application quality and reliability.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and help resolve issues identified during development and testing.
- Participate in learning about peer code reviews, ask questions, and apply feedback to improve code quality and maintainability.
- Learn and apply mobile development standards, secure coding practices, accessibility expectations, and platform-specific best practices.
- Support application integration with RESTful APIs, backend services, and approved third-party libraries.
- Use version control and team development practices to manage code changes effectively.
- Contribute to team knowledge sharing, technical documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
- Stay current with mobile operating system updates, development tools, and emerging technologies relevant to assigned work.
- Communicate progress, risks, questions, and outcomes clearly and professionally.
- Perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Curiosity, adaptability, accountability, and a willingness to learn from feedback and mentorship
- Foundational knowledge of object-oriented programming and software development concepts.
- Familiarity with some form of programming language
- Effective research, analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to maintain accuracy, demonstrate attention to detail, and meet deadlines.
- Effective organizational, planning, time-management, verbal, and written communication skills.
- Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively within a cross-functional team.


Desired Qualifications



- Have "pet projects" such as already building features or working on apps
- Experience with Debugging or Automation
- Experience in Authentication or Security
- Previous experience with other companies


Hours

Additional Information

Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM

Innovation is in our DNA… is it in yours?

Bombardier is a global leader in aviation, creating innovative and game-changing planes. Our products and services provide world-class experiences that set new standards in passenger comfort, energy efficiency, reliability and safety. We are a global organization focused on working together with a team spirit.

Your boarding pass will include… 

Several conferences, including:



- Meet An Executive
- Meet a Specialist
- Meet a Pilot
- Women Taking Flight


Learning more about Bombardier, including:



- Aircraft 101 conference
- Bombardier Products conference 
- Visits of the Bombardier sites 
- Bombardier Academy of Learning 


Many social/networking opportunities, including:



- Interns’ committee 
- Volunteering 
- Internal Case Competition
- 5 à 7, Potluck, and much more!


What are your contributions to the team?



- You are currently enrolled in the 3rd or 4th year of an undergraduate university program in an Engineering discipline.
- You bring strong programming and development foundations in Python, SQL, React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Git.
- You are experienced with the Microsoft Office Suite and capable of utilizing modern digital productivity tools. 
- You are detail-oriented, professional, and able to thrive collaboratively as a team player in a dynamic environment. 
- You possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English. 


How to thrive in this role?



- Design and deploy full-stack web applications and internal tools using React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS to support smart factory initiatives and manufacturing operations.
- Engineer backend automation scripts and data integration pipelines with Python and SQL, leveraging operational data to drive real-time insights and transformation on the shop floor.
- Build custom internal applications and management tools that streamline communication and workflows across cross-functional engineering teams.
- Assist with strategic software and digital transformation initiatives associated with advanced aircraft programs such as the Global 8000 and 55/6500. 
- Explore research on emerging software architectures and AI applications relevant to manufacturing operations, helping provide technical insights for upcoming pilot projects. 
- Prepare governance materials, technical documentation, and project updates for operational improvement projects reviewed by senior management.


Boarding Information:



- Location: Global 7500/8000
- Duration: 12 months
- Flexible workplace-Hybrid


It is important to note that our internship opportunities are open to students only, not new graduates. The base salary for this position is expected to range from CAD $17.95 to CAD $31.00 per hour. The applicable base salary will be determined based on various criteria, at Bombardier’s sole discretion, such as the candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications. All our interns may be required to occasionally travel outside of Canada for training/work purpose.
fit_why: Strong full-stack fit: React, TypeScript, Python, SQL, Git, but manufacturing focus

jd:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

About The Team

Making new supply chain planning solutions possible with Machine Learning is what our fast-growing team of developers is all about. We build creative solutions that solve real business problems for our Maestro users without the need for them to become Machine Learning experts.

We are looking for a talented candidate to join our development team for a placement. It’s an opportunity for you to get real hands-on experience with Machine Learning software development and all the components needed to deploy it into a production system.

Location

If in Ottawa or Toronto, you must be in the office at least three days a week. Other Canadian Locations - Remote

Term Duration

This is a full-time, 4, or 8-month position, starting January 2027. Extensions can typically be made after the internship has been started.

Co-op / Intern Eligibility

This position is open to co-ops and interns. To be eligible, you must be currently enrolled in full-time education or be a recent/upcoming graduate within 12 months of the placement end date.

Compensation range

$27.04 - $39.66 hourly rate. The final offer within this range will reflect the candidate’s skills, year of education, and experience.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy.

What You Will Do



-  As a Co-op/Intern on the ML team you will be treated like a full-time developer and get to work on everything from tech selection to production code on our latest projects 
-  You will be working with a mentor from whom you can learn and who will provide support and guidance 
-  Your projects may include development of new product ideas as well as demos to executives and patent applications 
-  You will have access to the training that you need and start to make an impact within a few weeks of joining the team 
-  You will write Python code for microservice architectures 
-  You will contribute to the continuous improvement of our AI platform, ensuring scalability and security. 
-  You will participate in agile processes such as sprint planning, huddles, pair programming and retrospectives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions. 

What We Are Looking For



-  You are curious and passionate about applying Machine Learning to solve real problems 
-  You’re always learning, trying out new ideas and experimenting with technology 
-  You love to work in a team to learn from and to teach others 
-  You like to develop new technology, business and people skills and you always welcome a challenge 
-  You have some hands-on experience with ML through work terms or hackathons, competitions, etc. 
-  Experience with optimization (linear programming, mixed integer problems, solvers) is an asset 
-  Experience in statistical inference and related concepts is an asset 
-  You’ve completed 2+ years in a Computer Science or Engineering program 

Some Technologies You'll Use



-  Python 
-  Docker 
-  Kubernetes 
-  Azure 
-  GitHub Actions 

 #Coop, #Internship, #Intern, 

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:



- Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
- Flexible work options
- Physical and mental well-being programs
- Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
- Mentorship programs, training, and career development
- Recognition programs and referral rewards
- Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.
fit_why: ML-focused dev role; Python and Docker match, but ML depth is thin

Job Description 
 
 The Future Talent Program within our Research & Development Division Data, AI, and Genome Sciences (DAGS) Department is offering internships that last 10-12 weeks. We have 1 open position in the AI/ML Methods & Modeling Group. Candidates can apply for the opportunity to be involved in one or more of the projects listed below. The projects are designed to enable students to further develop their skills and to evaluate if we are the right Company for their long-term goals. We are seeking highly motivated students with computational skillsets. 

 Location: Cambridge, MA 
 Term: Full-time, 12 weeks 

 AI/ML Methods & Modeling: 
 
• Develop statistical and computational methods/pipelines to analyze genetic and genomic datasets. 
• Analyze of large-scale human genetic and genomic datasets to facilitate discovery of novel targets and biomarkers of disease risk and progression. 
• Work within an integrated, interdisciplinary team supporting validation efforts, including bioinformatic analysis of bulk and single-cell sequencing.  
 Required Education and Skills: 
 
• Must be currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or related technical field. 
• Must be available to work full-time for 10-12 weeks beginning in May or June of 2027.  
• Excellent software design and development skills and strong proficiency in Python. 
• Strong proficiency in modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and experience implementing scalable solutions for complex tasks. 
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a multi-disciplinary team. 
• Interest in life sciences problems and disease biology, and willing to learn from and teach others. 
 Preferred Skills and Experience: 
 
• Experience fine-tuning foundation models on multiple GPUs is a strong plus. 
• Experience with biological foundation models (e.g., single-cell foundation models) is a strong plus. 
• Experience with biological data (e.g., perturb-seq) is a strong plus. 
• Publications in top-tier ML conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) is a strong plus.
